about_the_game:
Welcome to the Wild Frontier of Feathers and Dust.

In this open-world adventure, you will venture into a tough, sun-baked land where wild chickens wander freely. Capture and tame these feathery mischief-makers, create your own farm, and transform your simple coop into a successful ranch. Meet the locals, take on various jobs, and navigate perilous dunes filled with predators like foxes and hawks. Ensure your chickens are fed, content, and protected, or see your egg empire crumble under the blazing sun. Whether you are pursuing rare breeds across the desert, selling fresh eggs in the market, or enhancing your farm, each day presents new challenges.

Core Features

Catch and Tame Chickens 
Track down and capture wild chickens, each possessing unique characteristics.

Build Your Farm 
Create and expand your own ranch. Construct buildings, pens, and tools to ensure your flock flourishes.

Sell Produce 
Exchange eggs, meat, and other products for money to enhance your farm and unlock improvements.

Explore the Open World 
Wander through deserts, oases, and ancient ruins in search of rare breeds and valuable treasures.

Do Quests for Locals 
Assist quirky townspeople with their issues to gain rewards and build your reputation.

Defend Your Chickens 
Safeguard your flock from predators, severe weather, and the harsh environment.

Keep Them Happy 
A well-fed and cared-for chicken produces better eggs. Manage their hunger, thirst, and mood to maintain a productive flock.

name: Chicken Frontier
short_description: Catch, tame, and care for wild chickens in a sunbaked frontier full of dust, danger, and feathers. Build your farm, befriend the locals, and rise as the ultimate Chicken Tamer.
